decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that, subject to appropriate safeguarding conditions, the
proposed internal and external works would, because of their design, method of construction, practicality and appearance, be acceptable and would not cause undue harm to the special architectural and historic character of building. The proposal accords with Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development), B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and B.2.7 (Alterations to Listed Buildings) within the Unitary Development Plan (December 2003).
Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority a method statement proving that the minimum alteration to the historic fabric of the building required to install the proposed dry lining will be undertaken.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until referenced examples (including manufactures' statement) regarding the potential impacts of the proposed under floor heating have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - No development shall take place until fixed construction details regarding impacts upon existing ceiling, panelling and skirting have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. Specifically this would involve details on methods of fixing plywood flooring to existing floorboards and beams, installing soil and service pipes and installing dry lining over;a)	Existing timber panellingb)	Existing lath and plaster.
description: Internal alternations to change the existing building to change from commercial use to a single family house, incorporating external alterations and the reinstatement of 3 chimneys.
